description: Every 5 minutes, checks the inbox for replies to freed-slot offers sent by "Send approved slot offers". AI reads each reply (with the quoted offer trimmed off) and decides whether it's a YES. The first patient to say YES is booked into the slot in Cliniko, after checking nobody has taken it since: a patient already booked later has that booking moved into the slot, anyone else gets a new booking. They get a confirmation, everyone else who was offered the slot is told it's filled, and the WorkQ item is completed. A moved booking's old time is left for "Find freed slots to fill" to offer on. Unclear replies and Cliniko errors are commented on the WorkQ item for a human; if nobody says YES before the slot starts, the item is closed.
